t: The Fantastic Four by Ryan North: Fantastic For Fans and New Readers - Fountaindale Public Library
s: September 26, 2025 - Taken in all at once, the Fantastic Four are a lot. However, once you get to know the characters, they’re surprisingly grounded and approachable despite their illustrious history and sci-fi adventures. Ryan North’s take on the quartet showcases this, making it one of the most accessible and enjoyable Fantastic Four books ever written.
